query:
SELECT
       u.id AS user_id,
       u.email AS user_email,
       u.role AS user_role,
       COUNT(p.id) AS post_count,
       MAX(p.id) AS latest_post_id
     FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.user_id = u.id
     GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.role
     ORDER BY u.id DESC
     LIMIT $1::int OFFSET $2::int
